description: Acquires a service from an object by handle (generic GetService<T>) and returns a service HANDLE, to then invoke methods via tia_obj_invoke. E.g.: PlcMasterSecretConfigurator.Protect — unlocks a bare CPU (offline confidential-data password; generates the certificate). The acquisition itself does NOT mutate the project. Maps to POST /obj/{handle}/service {type}. M-off.

handle.description: object handle (e.g., the CPU's device item)

name: tia_obj_service
title: TIA — acquire service (GetService→handle)
